arguments.summary: Customer John Smith (C1001), line 555-123-2002 / L1002, is abroad in France with mobile data issue. Roaming was disabled initially; after explicit confirmation, international roaming was enabled successfully. Guided troubleshooting step-by-step: toggled Airplane Mode, enabled mobile data, disabled Data Saver, enabled Data Roaming, attempted manual network selection but customer cannot access that option, restarted phone. Checked usage: line was over 15.0 GB high-speed limit at 15.1 GB used; customer confirmed adding 2.0 GB data at $2/GB for $4 total, refuel completed successfully. Despite this, phone still shows poor signal, 2G, data enabled. Customer ran speed test: 0.05 Mbps, very poor. Needs excellent speed; likely local roaming coverage/partner network issue or requires advanced roaming/network support beyond available tools.
